Strategy: Reward bins within half a standard deviation of the mean residual, favouring typical bins over extremes, with Best Fit ordering elsewhere.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    v = sum([(x - m) ** 2 for x in bins]) / len(bins)
    s = sqrt(v)
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if abs(r - m) <= s / 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
